mcqs.question: What percentage of horizontal reservation was notified for meritorious sportspersons in direct recruitment to Andhra Pradesh government departments, local bodies, public sector undertakings and specified services in April 2025?
mcqs.explanation: Andhra Pradesh notified 3% horizontal reservation for meritorious sportspersons in direct recruitment. The 5-year period relates to the validity of the policy, while 65 refers to the sports covered.
